scope: Complete plaintext config.cpp text from six installed PBOs: LAMBS Suppression, Turrets and RPG vanilla/CUP/RHS/SOG. Not whole danger FSM, effective merged game config, current Workshop freshness or licence review.

1808238502.intent: Skill-dependent suppression recovery and AI aim-settling/turning response.
1808238502.sourcePolicy: Suppression component worst/best decrease25/4s and explosion weight1.5; aiming-error component worst/best decrease3.5/0.6s and turning influence1.2. Six properties, not six separately delivered features.
1808238502.cbe: Native component policy not implemented in CBE configs. Runtime danger/suppression reactions exist but do not establish equivalent engine decay/aim-settling dynamics.

1862208264.intent: Less precise and sustained AI turret fire through brain error plus weapon/mode dispersion and burst policy.
1862208264.cbe: Optional restart-required turret aiming PBO sets maxAngularErrorTurrets0.12 versus source0.15. It does not implement source RCWS/HMG/coax per-mode AI dispersion/nonterminable burst or autocannon dispersion changes. Numerical difference is not proof of improvement.
1862208264.disposition: Selected partial policy exists. Do not import nonterminable bursts without accounting for mission fire policy and friendly-lane changes; physical lethality/balance unverified.

1858070328.intent: Broader native RPG target use, range/preference, cadence and dispersion; optional CUP/RHS/SOG class adapters.
1858070328.cbe: Scripted anti-armour selection/backblast and capability classification exist; no matching native launcher weapon/ammunition configuration policy. This is not full RPG-source functionality.
1858070328.disposition: AI-only flags/preferences must be evaluated separately from dispersion, recoil/sound and CUP airFriction changes that can affect player weapons/ballistics. No whole-config transplant.

confirmedNextRuntimeGap: CortexAntiArmour checks rear geometry/friendly backblast then doTarget/doFire, but has no shared CortexLineOfFireClear forward/blast veto. Any fix must use actual loaded launcher ammunition and avoid letting an unloaded preferred carrier starve a ready carrier; preserve native selection/reload and mission ammo overrides.
